lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gills, organized into approximately five distinct vertical alignments with larger, more isolated nodes positioned dorsally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are coincident with the vertical columns of blobs, forming a grid-like structure where the highest-intensity spots serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible across the mid and upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density statistical distribution of small, high-luminance blobs that are significantly smaller and more closely packed than those on the lateral flank.
